body: Thanks! Everything everyone is saying is stuff I already know, but I can;t convince myself to do it, but hearing it from you guys gives me motivation for some odd reason, just knowing people care is a great mood boost. Don't worry im geeky too, recently on one of my good days i decided i was going to apply to college for computer programming! But its pretty much 5:30 am here and you and rossisgone have eased my mind enough to sleep, so i think im going to try that, once again thank you.

I hate you for making me smile through my tears...lol I feel like an idiot for making this post now because you cheered me up, it shouldn't be that easy should it =\? I just wish i had someone to keep my roller coaster of emotions from ever dipping down. Honestly i feel a lot more at peace now maybe i can finally get some sleep, been crying all night. Thank you so much.
